articles.summary: A Newmarket man is facing more than 50 charges following a series of alleged break and enters at commercial businesses in surrounding areas. articles.title: Cyclist collides into tow truck door near Bloor and Church, seriously injured
articles.summary: A cyclist was rushed to hospital on Tuesday morning after he slammed into the door of a tow truck that was being opened, Toronto police say. Emergency crews were called to the area of Bloor Street West and Church Street just before 8:15 a.m. Paramedics say they transported the man to a trauma centre with […]

articles.title: Serena Williams is back at the US Open, playing mixed doubles with Carlos Alcaraz
articles.summary: NEW YORK (AP) — Serena Williams is back at the U.S. Open for her first match at the Grand Slam tournament since 2022, playing mixed doubles alongside defending men's singles champion Carlos Alcaraz.

articles.title: Female pedestrian dead after being struck by Corvette in Newmarket: York police
articles.summary: A woman has died after being struck by a motor vehicle in Newmarket, Ont., Monday night, police say.

articles.summary: A woman has died after being struck by a vehicle in Newmarket late Monday night, prompting a major collision investigation and road closures that are expected to continue into the morning, York Regional Police (YRP) say. articles.title: A federal tariff targeted Chinese EVs. But a Pickering golf trolley company is facing a $183K bill
articles.summary: A Pickering, Ont., business owner who sells golf trolleys says he’s being unfairly taxed under a now-defunct federal tariff intended for Chinese EVs.

articles.title: Hate crimes unit investigating incident at Bathurst and Sheppard: Toronto police
articles.summary: Toronto police's hate crimes unit is investigating an incident in North York on the weekend that Jewish groups say was "blatant antisemitism."

articles.title: 1 house destroyed, 2 others damaged in 'suspicious' Ajax fire, police say
articles.summary: Police say an early morning fire in Ajax that destroyed one house and damaged two others nearby on Monday has been deemed suspicious.

articles.title: SIU clears police officer involved in Etobicoke crash that injured 18-year-old
articles.summary: Ontario's Special Investigations Unit has cleared a Toronto police officer of wrongdoing after his cruiser collided with a car in Etobicoke in a crash that seriously injured an 18-year-old man earlier this year.

articles.title: Downed tree blocks traffic in Toronto's Moss Park neighbourhood
articles.summary: A large tree that has fallen across Dundas Street E. near Sherbourne Street is blocking traffic on Monday.

articles.title: Ford doubles down on 'kiss my ass' comment to Trump amid Canada-U.S. trade war
articles.summary: Ontario Premier Doug Ford called U.S. President Donald Trump a dictator and said he can "kiss my ass" while speaking at a news conference in Hamilton as the fallout of the Canada-U.S. trade war continues.

articles.title: Cyclist dead after colliding with parked trailer last week in Whitby, Ont., police say
articles.summary: A 68-year-old cyclist has died following a collision in Whitby, Ont., last week. On Friday, Durham police responded to a collision involving a male cyclist in the area of Coronation Road and Lyndebrook Road, according to a statement.

articles.title: Psychological stress in Ontario youth is down since the pandemic, suggests survey
articles.summary: The Centre for Addiction and Mental Health says psychological distress among Ontario youth appears to have decreased since the pandemic, but is still much higher than a decade ago.
